title: Greeting Neighbors Warmly
paragraphs: Since moving into his apartment building, Tariq makes a habit of greeting his neighbors by name whenever he passes them in the hallway, even the ones he barely knows beyond a quick exchange.
At first, a few neighbors seem surprised, since most people in the building simply nod without speaking or avoid eye contact entirely while checking their phones in the elevator.

Over several months, Tariq notices that more residents start greeting each other too, and small conversations in the hallway become a normal, welcome part of everyone's day rather than an awkward exception.

One neighbor later tells him that his simple greetings made the building feel less like a place of strangers. Tariq realizes that a small habit of adab can quietly shape an entire community's atmosphere.
